name: Monaco (municipality)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the arms of the Commune of Monaco: a monk with a raised sword holding the red-and-white lozengy shield of the Grimaldi, beneath a gold crown.
history: The commune of Monaco, coextensive with the principality, adopted its white flag with the municipal arms in the summer of 1961; the municipality's organisation was laid down by Law 959 of 24 July 1974.

features.role: arms of the commune — the monk François Grimaldi with sword and lozengy shield, crowned
features.symbolism: the capture of the fortress of Monaco in 1297 by Grimaldi disguised as a monk
